core.Health/max: A hundred hit points: a round number every damage figure is read against (CMB-01)
core.Resistance/hack: No armour: every unit is unarmoured until its template says otherwise
core.Resistance/pierce: No armour: every unit is unarmoured until its template says otherwise
core.Resistance/crush: No armour: every unit is unarmoured until its template says otherwise
core.Attack/Melee/hack: No melee attack: a unit whose amounts are all 0 has none (CMB-02)
core.Attack/Melee/pierce: No melee attack: a unit whose amounts are all 0 has none (CMB-02)
core.Attack/Melee/crush: No melee attack: a unit whose amounts are all 0 has none (CMB-02)
core.Attack/Melee/reach: A block between the two bodies' edges, an arm's length
core.Attack/Melee/prepare: Half a second's wind-up before the first blow, so an attack reads
core.Vision/range: Twelve blocks: an enemy at the edge of the default camera's view is noticed (CMB-02)
core.Behaviour/flee: Units stand their ground unless their template says they run

strategos:template/unit_base.UnitMotion/walkSpeed: 3.75 blocks a second, a little under a walking player's 4.3, so a crowd reads as marching; M1's movement baselines are measured at it (D-11)
strategos:template/unit_base.UnitMotion/turnRate: Degrees a tick: a full turn in eight ticks, quick enough for orders to feel immediate, slow enough to see the turn
strategos:template/unit_base.Body/width: A player's hit box, so the vanilla humanoid model fits (D-04)
strategos:template/unit_base.Body/height: A player's hit box, so the vanilla humanoid model fits (D-04)
strategos:template/unit_base.Body/radius: The avoidance radius, a little over half the width, so a dense crowd still shows gaps between bodies (M1, PATH-06)

strategos:unit/debug_walker.UnitMotion/walkSpeed: Five blocks a second: the movement tests' brisk walker, never a game unit

strategos:unit/infantry.Attack/Melee/hack: With 100 hit points and resistance 5, one spearman kills another in 29 blows, about half a minute at a blow a second (M2, CMB-02)
strategos:unit/infantry.Attack/Melee/reach: A spear reaches a little past an arm's length
strategos:unit/infantry.Attack/Melee/prepare: Half a second's wind-up before the first thrust, so a charge reads
strategos:unit/infantry.Resistance/hack: 0.9^5 lets 59 % through: shield and padding make a fight between two spearmen last tens of seconds
strategos:unit/infantry.Resistance/crush: Padding does little against blunt blows; crush belongs to cavalry and siege later
strategos:unit/infantry.Cost/resources/wood: Forty wood: the shaft and the shield; wood gathered early goes to both houses and soldiers
strategos:unit/infantry.Cost/population: One house's room for one soldier, as for a worker

strategos:unit/worker.Health/max: Half a spearman's: a raid on workers costs their owner dearly, so workers are worth guarding
strategos:unit/worker.Behaviour/flee: Eight blocks from a blow: out of a spearman's reach, near enough to go back to work
strategos:unit/worker.Cost/resources/food: Sixty food: the civic centre's first worker pays back its cost in about a minute of berry picking
strategos:unit/worker.Cost/population: One house's room for one worker
strategos:unit/worker.Cost/time: Ten seconds: a civic centre with a full queue adds a worker every ten seconds, the pace the first house's timing target (1:30) assumes
strategos:unit/worker.Builder/rate: One builder's worth: a building's time is what one worker takes, and more builders add with diminishing returns (BLD-03)
strategos:unit/worker.ResourceGatherer/rates/food/fruit: A berry a second: a bush's sixty food in a minute, so the first worker pays back its own cost quickly
strategos:unit/worker.ResourceGatherer/rates/wood/tree: Slower than picking: a log's twenty wood in about half a minute, so an oak keeps a worker busy for a few minutes
strategos:unit/worker.ResourceGatherer/capacities/food: Ten food a trip: short trips, so a bush near the centre keeps food coming steadily
strategos:unit/worker.ResourceGatherer/capacities/wood: Ten wood a trip, half a log: eight trips pay for the first house (the timing target, 1:30)

resource_yield.#minecraft:logs: Twenty wood a log: an oak of four or five logs holds about ninety, a few minutes of one worker's chopping
resource_yield.#minecraft:leaves: Leaves yield nothing: they are the canopy that thins as a tree is felled (ECO-03)
resource_yield.#minecraft:base_stone_overworld: Five stone a block of rock: indexed now, gathered from ECO-07 (M4)
resource_yield.#c:ores/iron: Ten iron a block of ore: indexed now, gathered from ECO-08 (M4)
resource_yield.minecraft:sweet_berry_bush: Sixty food a bush, a worker's cost; a bush left alone fills again in ten minutes, but an emptied one stays empty: early food that runs out, so fields matter (ECO-09)

strategos:building/civic_centre.Health/max: Two thousand: ten spearmen with torches take minutes, so a raid alone does not end a match (CMB-03)
strategos:building/civic_centre.Cost/resources/wood: Three hundred wood: a second centre is a late, deliberate expansion, not an opening move
strategos:building/civic_centre.Cost/resources/stone: Two hundred stone: stone matters from M4; until then only the starting centre exists
strategos:building/civic_centre.Cost/time: Two and a half minutes: the largest build of the first loop
strategos:building/civic_centre.Housing/capacity: Twenty: the five starting workers and fifteen more before the first house is needed
strategos:building/civic_centre.Placement/civicReach: None: a civic centre stands where its spacing allows, not near another
strategos:building/civic_centre.Placement/spacing: Sixty-four blocks between centres: a second centre claims new ground, not a corner of the first's

strategos:template/building_base.Placement/civicReach: Within 48 blocks of an own centre's footprint: a town grows round its centre, the stand-in for territory until TERR-02

strategos:building/house.Health/max: Four hundred: a house burns in well under a minute to a squad (CMB-03)
strategos:building/house.Cost/resources/wood: Eighty wood: a worker's first trip or two to a tree; the first house by 1:30 (the timing target)
strategos:building/house.Housing/capacity: Five: a house a few trainings, so housing paces growth

strategos:building/barracks.Health/max: Twelve hundred: between a house and the centre
strategos:building/barracks.Cost/resources/wood: Two hundred wood: the barracks by 4:00 (the timing target) after a house and steady chopping
